name: pi-cowboy
description: 🤠 Agent orchestrator for pi. It can manage Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, pi, pig and pi-bolt as subagents and handover sessions in between them. Runs subagents in background Herdr panes, isolated in copy-on-write Git worktrees.
